response.sql: WITH equipment_humidity AS (SELECT e.equipregistry AS equipref, AVG(se.humepct) AS avg_humidity FROM equipment AS e LEFT JOIN scanenvironment AS se ON se.equipref = e.equipregistry GROUP BY e.equipregistry), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS overall_avg FROM equipment_humidity), above_average AS (SELECT eh.* FROM equipment_humidity AS eh CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE eh.avg_humidity > o.overall_avg), group_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS above_group_avg FROM above_average) SELECT a.equipref, a.avg_humidity, a.avg_humidity - o.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg, a.avg_humidity - g.above_group_avg AS difference_from_group_mean FROM above_average AS a CROSS JOIN overall AS o CROSS JOIN group_mean AS g WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND g.above_group_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference_from_group_mean DESC NULLS LAST, a.equipref LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The all-equipment average is the mean of per-equipment humidity averages; equipment without readings contributes no average.

alternatives.interpretation: The all-equipment average is the mean of all nonmissing humidity readings, so equipment with more readings has more weight in that reference average.
